note: Two HUD lanterns made as a pair: the health lantern first, then the release lantern generated with the chosen health lantern as its reference and style image. Native pixels, no resampling or repainting. The game splits each frame at its glass window (layout.json): the window's own pixels are drawn under the ember / life light, the rest of the frame over it.

assets.prompt: A single small standing brass lantern, front view, symmetric, about 22 px wide and 36 px tall, centered with its base at the bottom of the canvas. Small ring handle on top, stepped domed cap with a tiny red heart-shaped gem in the middle, four thin dark iron posts framing ONE tall rectangular glass window, stepped square base. The glass window is completely EMPTY and dark inside: no candle, no flame, no light. Crisp native pixel art for a dark cozy lantern-lit animal roguelike HUD. Top-left light, 1px near-black violet outline, aged warm brass and blackened iron, restricted warm muted palette, strong material planes, readable at original size. No background, no floor, no cast shadow, no outer glow, no text, no UI frame. No smooth painting or blur.
assets.operation: The downloaded candidate tile is shifted by one column (its left edge wrapped to x=27); rolled one column right, then cropped to its 18x32 bounds. No other pixel change.

assets.referenceImage: lantern_health.png (the chosen health lantern; reference + style image)
